features.label: Sentences
features.definition: Number of sentences detected by the UD parser.

features.label: Word tokens
features.definition: Number of UD word tokens, distinct from the number of language-model subword tokens.

features.label: Words per sentence
features.definition: Mean number of UD word tokens per parser-detected sentence.

features.label: Characters per word
features.definition: Mean number of characters per non-punctuation UD token.

features.label: Mean dependency length
features.definition: Mean absolute head-dependent distance in UD tokens, excluding punctuation dependencies.

features.label: Maximum dependency length

features.label: Mean tree depth

features.label: Subordinate chain depth
features.definition: Mean depth of recursively embedded subordinate-clause chains.

features.label: Words per clause
features.definition: Mean number of UD tokens per clause.

features.label: Dependencies per verb
features.definition: Mean number of eligible dependency links attached to each verbal head, excluding punctuation and copular links.

features.label: Subordinate clauses
features.definition: Percentage of clauses classified as subordinate rather than main clauses.

features.label: Sentences with verbal roots
features.definition: Percentage of parser-detected sentences whose dependency root is tagged as VERB.

features.label: Subjects before verbs
features.definition: Percentage of subject dependents preceding their governing verbal head.

features.label: Objects after verbs
features.definition: Percentage of core-object dependents following their governing verbal head.

features.label: Subordinate clauses after heads
features.definition: Percentage of subordinate-clause heads following their governing head.

features.label: Compound dependencies

features.label: Nominal modifiers

features.label: Nominal subjects
features.definition: Percentage of UD dependency relations labelled nominal subject.

features.label: Core objects
features.definition: Percentage of UD dependency relations labelled core object.

features.label: Oblique nominals
features.definition: Percentage of UD dependency relations labelled oblique nominal.

features.label: Coordinating conjunctions

features.label: Common nouns

features.label: Numerals
